decisions.reason: Candidate 02 is the only candidate passing all hard gates, and mask review shows a localized coherent moderate immune transition with complete quota and preserved surrounding structures.

decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei occupy authorized changed tissue and transition; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with sampling score 0.892.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.

decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 02 as the single mask-condition handoff.
